about_subtitle: An ongoing practice in electronic music.
about_note: Adapted from the HEADBIRDS press kit, with the broader artistic practice included.
about_paragraph_1: For around two decades, HEADBIRDS has developed a sound that resists easy categorisation. House provides the warmth, electro introduces syncopation, and techno gives the music its physical force. The result moves between genres without settling into one.
about_paragraph_2: Across EPs and albums including Kulturhaus and Atzar , that approach has travelled through clubs and festivals from Barcelona and Paris to New York, Hong Kong and Bangkok.
about_paragraph_3: But the work extends beyond records and DJ sets. Creating spaces for music and for other artists — including Les Arcs, L’Estrany and COREA, among other projects — belongs to the same restless artistic impulse.

spaces_les_arcs_description:
Les Arcs Club

A truly one-of-a-kind space, Les Arcs is set within an 800-year-old Catalan farmhouse, surrounded by nature. A club with impeccable sound, where the intensity of electronic music meets the beauty and tranquility of the natural world.

More than a club, Les Arcs was conceived as a place for connection, experimentation and shared experiences. A meeting point for music, people and ideas, built around the belief that creating the right environment can be just as meaningful as creating the music itself.
spaces_lestrany_description:
L’ESTRANY - FESTIVAL DE MÚSICA INSÒLITA

For nine editions, this tiny festival transformed Pla de l’Estrany (Girona, Spain) into a place where music, people and imagination came together.

What made it truly special was the collective spirit of the people behind it, its extraordinary locations and the almost magical atmosphere that emerged in each space.

Driven by curiosity and an instinct for discovering new talent, the festival welcomed artists such as Rosalía, Orbe, Alizzz and Carles Viarnés long before they gained the recognition they enjoy today.

More than a festival, L’Estrany was a shared vision — a celebration of creativity, intuition and the belief that something extraordinary can happen when the right people come together in the right place.
spaces_corea_description:
COREA — ROBADORS 23

A serie of intimate DJ sessions held at the legendary Robadors 23, a small and welcoming venue in Barcelona’s Raval neighbourhood, deeply rooted in the city’s jazz and flamenco culture.

Bringing together some of the finest selectors from Barcelona and Catalonia, COREA offered each artist five hours to explore unexpected musical directions, take risks and build a journey beyond the conventions of a typical club set.

Artists such as Alicia Carrera, DJ Gus and Abu Sou were part of a project where musical curiosity, careful selection and the closeness between DJ and audience created something genuinely special.

More than a series of parties, COREA was a celebration of the art of listening, sharing music and letting it unfold naturally.
